about: Son of Ser Forrest Frey and Sabitha Vypren; he became Lord of the Crossing after his father's death in 130 AC. His name is not known.

A promising young jouster, he was unhorsed by Uthor Underleaf at Whitewalls. His cousin, the bride at the wedding tourney, fainted when he fell.

Called Bloodborn, he became an outlaw. His crimes and later fate are not described.
Born in 286 AC, Robert is Rhaegar Frey's eldest son by Jeyne Beesbury. One of Lord Walder's great-grandchildren, he is the older brother of White Walda and Jonos.
Known as White Walda. Her mother died of a wasting illness; her father disappeared after his visit to White Harbor.
Jonos, born in 291 AC, is Rhaegar Frey's younger son by Jeyne Beesbury. Robert and White Walda are his older siblings.
Perriane is Walder Frey's eldest daughter by Perra Royce. She married Ser Leslyn Haigh and has three sons: Harys, Donnel, and Alyn.
Zia was born in 285 AC to Tytos Frey and Zhoe Blanetree. Her brother Zachery studies at the sept in Oldtown.
Trained at a sept in Oldtown.
Lost her husband and brother during the Red Wedding. Her father later disappeared in the North.

Visited Saltpans after its devastation, then remained at Darry among the Frey relatives supporting Amerei and Lancel's household.
Ryella, born in 294 AC, is Arwood Frey's eldest child by Ryella Royce. She shares her mother's name and has younger twin brothers, Androw and Alyn.
Androw is one of Arwood Frey and Ryella Royce's twin sons, born in 295 or 296 AC. His twin is Alyn; their sisters are Ryella and Hostella.
Alyn is Androw Frey's twin, a son of Arwood Frey and Ryella Royce born in 295 or 296 AC. His sisters are Ryella and Hostella.
A newborn by the events of A Dance with Dragons.
Lythene is Walder's second daughter and his only daughter by Amarei Crakehall. She married Lord Lucias Vypren and has two children, Elyana and Damon.
A singer sent away from the Twins before Edmure's wedding. Catelyn noticed that he, Olyvar and Perwyn were all absent, an omission that heightened her unease before the massacre.
Presented to Robb among the Frey women and attended Edmure's wedding.
Sent to Braavos to be fostered by the merchant Oro Tendyris.

Helped negotiate Catelyn's crossing agreement. Captured on the Green Fork and later ransomed, he took part in the Red Wedding and subsequently met Jaime at Darry. Miscarriages and stillbirths left his marriage childless.

Tysane, born in 292 AC, is the eldest daughter of Lame Lothar Frey and Leonella Lefford. Her younger sisters are Walda, Emberlei, and Leana.
Born in 294 or 295 AC, Walda is Lothar Frey's second daughter by Leonella Lefford. She is distinct from both Roose Bolton's wife, Fat Walda, and Edwyn Frey's daughter of the same name.
